topic: Properties and characteristics of light and sound
key_concepts: Aligned holes allow light to pass through
Some objects reflect light and some do not
Transparent objects let light pass through clearly
Some common sources produce loud sounds while others produce soft sounds
Sound is produced by vibrations and travels through air and solid materials like string
In a string telephone, vibrations pass from one cup to another through the string
Refraction is the bending of light as it moves from one medium to another
Sound intensity is measured in decibels and varies by source
Very high sound intensity can damage the eardrum
